mapper.select: SELECT FROM cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at, cart_item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item ( cart_item_id, cart_id, user_id, product_id, sku_id, quantity, is_selected, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{cartItemId}, #{cartId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item SET quantity = #{quantity}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
